text:
The Model Context Protocol (MCP)↗ lets AI assistants talk to your systems directly—no copy-paste, no context switching. Ramp ships three MCP servers, each scoped to a different audience.

The three Ramp MCP servers

Ramp MCPConnect AI assistants to your Ramp account for analysis and employee workflows.Developer MCPReal-time API docs and implementation guidance while building with Ramp.Ramp Data MCPQuery public Ramp Rate benchmarks and AI Index adoption metrics — one server, both datasets.

What you can build with MCP

AI AgentsConnect agents to Ramp via MCP or the CLI — read data, process approvals, make purchases.AI IndexQuery business AI adoption metrics — overall, by sector, by company size.Ramp RatePull vendor and category benchmarks into research, prompts, and product flows.
